Due to regulatory and terrain restrictions, a direct fiber link cannot be established between Hub Alpha and Hub Beta. Furthermore, due to a bandwidth-sharing agreement, exactly one of the following two high-capacity links must be incorporated into the final ring topology: the connection between Beta and Gamma, or the connection between Gamma and Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal total cable length required to construct a closed ring network that interconnects each hub precisely once and returns to the originating hub.
